title: The world keeps changing
odia: ବେଙ୍ଗ କହେ ବେଙ୍ଗୁଲିଲୋ ପୃଥ୍ଵୀ ଘଡ଼ିକେ ଆନ ।
literal_meaning: The frog tells the female frog: the world is different from one moment to the next.
explanation: Circumstances do not remain as they were. The animal conversation makes a simple observation about change, without saying that every change is good or bad.
meaning_odia: ବେଙ୍ଗ ଓ ବେଙ୍ଗୁଲିର କଥାରେ ପୃଥିବୀର ବଦଳୁଥିବା ରୂପ ଧରାପଡ଼ିଛି। ଯାହାକୁ ଏବେ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ଭାବୁଛୁ, କିଛି ସମୟ ପରେ ତାହା ଅଲଗା ହୋଇପାରେ। ଏଥିରେ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନକୁ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ କରିବାର ଭାବ ଅଛି, ସବୁ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଭଲ ବା ସବୁ ଖରାପ ବୋଲି ରାୟ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A familiar market has changed so much that a returning visitor must learn its new arrangements. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source explicitly glosses changing circumstances; the dialogue is not attached to a verified folktale here.
